meta.what: OEEF probe (CuAl): uniform E-field along the C...C axis vs coupling barrier, metal+2*CO cluster, DF-RKS PBE/def2-SVP, warm-chain in field
meta.geometry_source: ts_barrier.profile of co2_to_fuels_results.json (reactant d=4.2, TS d=2.6), build_ads reconstruction
meta.honesty: cluster != electrode; uniform field != double layer; PBE underestimates the barrier (known); frozen metal; def2-SVP. This measures SENSITIVITY dE^/dF, not an operating potential.
meta.flip_motivation: 44q full-CAS showed weak/saturated correlation (n_u~0.49) -> the lever for co2 coupling is electrostatics, not quantum correlation

summary.note: dΔE‡/dF вдоль оси C···C; знак минус = поле в +x снижает барьер. Кластер/PBE/однородное поле — чувствительность, не предсказание потенциала.

honest_analysis.outlier: F=-0.51 V/A point (0.5115 eV) breaks the otherwise monotonic trend — suspected SCF branch hop at extreme field; EXCLUDED from the slope
honest_analysis.zero_field_consistency: barrier(F=0)=0.9937 eV matches the published warm-branch CuAl barrier 0.992 eV -> SAME SCF branch as the profile (branch-lock passed, unlike Cu2 v1)
honest_analysis.physics: asymmetric CuAl site has d(mu)!=0 -> first-order Stark handle CONFIRMED: field +0.5 V/A along C-C lowers the coupling barrier by ~0.2 eV (~x2000 rate at 300K), field -0.26 V/A raises it by ~0.1 eV
honest_analysis.contrast: symmetric Cu2 (v1): no first-order handle (symmetry); alloy site: strong handle -> 'alloying makes the barrier FIELD-TUNABLE', selectivity via electrode, not via chemistry
